overclaims: Morris and colleagues proposed an AGI classification framework on June 5, 2024, but that framework does not establish criteria for Marcus's forecast [e1; marcus-this-one-important-fact-about-current-d4d5f8-o1].
checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim, and the proposition, conditions, axis, horizon and outcome all match. The e1 metadata matches the evidence item. The problem is the rationale's date. The arXiv record shows the framework was first submitted on 4 Nov 2023. June 5, 2024 is only the date of the v4 revision, so 'proposed ... on June 5, 2024' gets the date wrong. Suggested fix: 'in a version available June 5, 2024 (first posted Nov 2023)'.
